No Shapiro-Wilk p is below .05, so nothing here argues against normality. That is weaker evidence than it sounds when groups are small. No sign of unequal spread, but with a group under 10 people this test almost never fires, even when the spreads differ a lot. Compare the SDs in the table yourself. With fewer than 20 values these tests have little power and miss real departures; with several hundred they flag differences too small to matter. Treat them as a prompt to look at the plot, not as a verdict.
